Name: start
Description: You stand in the foyer of a Hunted house. East to hallway. Down to basement.

Name: hall
Description: The hall whispers. A door and a dusty mirror wait.

Name: candles
Description: Lit candles around a table. A planchette rests on a board.

Name: passage
Description: Smoke swirls. A loose panel reveals a narrow passage.
MenuB: Follow it to an iron door

Name: basement
Description: The stairs creak. Wet stone and a steady drip below.

Name: cellar
Description: A dingy cellar: old freezer and shelves of jars.

Name: jars_key
Description: A small tarnished key hangs on a hook.
MenuB: Find a door for the key

Name: iron_door
Description: You find an iron door with a lock and a stone pedestal with a skull.

Name: mirror_bad
Description: The mirror smiles back, then pulls you in. You lose.

Name: seance_bad
Description: The planchette jerks. Darkness swallows you. You lose.

Name: echo_bad
Description: Whispers answer. The step snaps you fall. You lose.

Name: freezer_bad
Description: A frozen hand grabs you. The lid slams. You lose.

Name: skull_bad
Description: Bones clatter and trap you. You lose.

Name: amulet_win
Description: You lift a warm amulet. The front door opens. You win!
